task.title: Editing tags in the Haystack tagsImportFile and equipImportFile
task.shortdesc: Editing Haystack tags, tag groups, and relations is performed entirely through the generated JSON import files. JSON import files provide a structured, schema‑validated way to adjust any element of the Haystack dictionary.

keywords.indexterm: edit Tags Import FileEquip Import File

step.cmd: Locate the generated tagsImport.json or equipImport.json file in the folder you selected.
Open the file in a JSON‑aware editor.
step.info:
Each tag appears as a JSON object under tagDefinitions. You may:
Change tag properties such as kind, units, validity, or custom attributes.
Add new tags by inserting new JSON objects.
Mark a tag for removal by including: "remove": true
Removing a tag requires an explicit "remove": true flag. Simply omitting the tag from the JSON file does not delete it.Under the tagGroups array, you can:
Add or remove tags within a group.
Adjust group validity rules.
Create new groups or retire old ones using the same "remove": true structure.

Under the tagGroups array, you can:
Add or remove tags within a group.
Adjust group validity rules.
Create new groups or retire old ones using the same "remove": true structure.

Relation definitions appear under relationDefinitions. You can:
Add new relations.
Modify existing relations.
Remove relations using the "remove": true flag.

Once your edits are complete:
Save the JSON file.
Return to the station's HsTagDictionary component.
Invoke Import Dictionary.
Select the updated JSON file.
step.stepresult: validates the JSON structure and applies your modifications to the station dictionary.

result.note: To use the import files you must copy them to a folder on a target station. On a remote platform, use the File Transfer Client to copy the files from the PC to the station’s “shared” folder.
